parameters.content:
## Module 3 — Pricing & commercial logic
Entry: **Execute Workflow Trigger** receiving `{ client_id, client_config?, data:{ materials_cost, hours_by_category } }`.

**Read Pricing Sheet** loads the client's rate card at runtime from their **pricing Google Sheet** (`client_config.pricing_sheet_id`, tab named `Pricing`) — pricing data lives in each client's Drive folder, not the repo. Sheet layout (`type | key | value`): `docs/PRICING-SHEET-TEMPLATE.md`. **Build Rate Card** turns the rows into the rate_card object (an inline `client_config.rate_card` overrides the sheet).

**Compute Pricing** is plain **JavaScript** (self-hosted n8n has no Python). Formula mirrored in `modules/pricing/pricing_core.js`. It prices only the categories in `hours_by_category` (already filtered to the request's scope by the orchestrator). Negative / out-of-range inputs raise — never a silent wrong quote.

⚠️ After import: open **Read Pricing Sheet**, link the Google Sheets credential and confirm the tab (`Pricing`).
